name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck orders and kitchen
promotionalText: Accept pre-orders, protect your kitchen from more orders than it can handle, and continue your service even if the connection drops. An ordering app made for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is an ordering and kitchen app made for food trucks; the tool your team runs its trading session with.

Customers order ahead and also choose a collection time. Your staff see all orders on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can cook, then mark the order “Ready” and “Collected”.

■ Don’t promise a time you can’t meet
Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how much time it takes. When a collection time fills up, customers can’t choose it; so the queue matches the kitchen’s capacity.

■ Take orders at the truck
Add walk-up orders on one screen together with the orders placed ahead; so the kitchen works from one queue.

■ One screen for the kitchen
The kitchen screen (KDS) shows what needs preparing now, what is next and what is ready; it also gives a notification when an order needs starting.

■ Print order tickets
Connect your kitchen receipt printer using Bluetooth or your local network; order tickets then print automatically.

■ Continue your service even if the connection drops
Switch on offline protection; if the connection drops, pre-ordering stops for a while, so nobody can place an order you won’t see. Orders you take on the device are saved, and sync when you are back online.

■ Made for the food truck
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during the trading session, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app using Face ID or Touch ID.

■ Plan your week
Set up your events and places once; and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is made for food truck owners and their staff. To sign in you need a HatchGrab account.
